newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste says trading risks smaller in 97, 98.
newsitem.headline: Neste says trading risks smaller in 97, 98.

text.p: Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its risk for oil trading losses in 1997 and 1998 were significantly smaller than this year.

The company, which had earlier estimated that its oil trading would have a 285 million markka sales margin deficit this year, said it issued the statement as clarification after media reports about its trading losses.
"On the years 1997 and 1998, it can be said that, due to the structure of open positions and smaller volumes, their possible losses are much smaller than this year," Neste said.

Daily newspaper Helsingin Sanomat on Wednesday quoted unnamed sources as saying that the highest estimate of total losses was 460 million markka. Neste's statement neither confirmed nor denied that this figure had been presented.

"Yesterday, the supervisory board was briefed on the impact of crude oil price fluctuations on future losses. This varies as price levels change and it would not be justified to publish the loss estimate on a daily basis," Neste said.
Neste said its warning of the 285 million markka deficit "takes into account the loss realised by July 25, 1996 and the possible loss for the rest of the year at that day's prices."
Neste said it would release its next estimate of the loss in its January-August interim report due on October 11 at 0900/0600 GMT.
